data.passage: billing-service will fetch auth-service's JWKS once at startup and cache the key
data.text: web-app fetched the JWKS only on boot; staging JWKS fetch errors from web-app paged for 47m [1][2]. The follow-up was web-app v4.8.2 refreshing every 10 minutes (commit #7) [3][4]. Caching for process life repeats that failure on rotation.

data.subject: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests on the public API
data.fix_that_worked: CS-3, Globex: 429s on the public API, resolved by Karthik Valluri by moving them to the higher-tier key (ticket last updated 2026-10-22).

tickets.text:
✓ Ticket Desk (0s)
TD-104 “HTTP 429 Too Many Requests on the public API”
→ repeat, 7 cited sources: Soylent's nightly sync sends about 300 requests/min to the public API and started getting 429s about two weeks ago. Rate limiter v2 (SBX-9) shipped around then, with a 100 requests/min default per API
→ fix that worked before: CS-3, Globex: 429s on the public API, resolved by Karthik Valluri by moving them to the higher-tier key (ticket last updated 2026-10-22).
